text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Stable Angina Pectoris due to Coronary Artery Disease. The ECG findings of ST segment depression during exertion, combined with your description of central chest pain radiating to the left arm and jaw triggered by physical activity, are classic signs of myocardial ischemia. I recommend starting you on anti-anginal medication and scheduling a stress test to assess the extent of the blockage.
